import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    claims = inputs["claims"].copy()
    
    # Initialize a boolean mask to track which rows have been matched
    matched = pd.Series([False] * len(claims), index=claims.index)
    
    # Initialize output lists for each port
    fast_track_rows = []
    high_value_rows = []
    manual_review_rows = []
    standard_rows = []
    
    # Rule 1: amount <= 500 and photos_attached == 1
    mask1 = (claims["amount"] <= 500) & (claims["photos_attached"] == 1)
    fast_track_rows.append(claims[mask1 & ~matched])
    matched = matched | mask1
    
    # Rule 2: amount > 10000
    mask2 = claims["amount"] > 10000
    high_value_rows.append(claims[mask2 & ~matched])
    matched = matched | mask2
    
    # Rule 3: photos_attached == 0 or amount > 500
    mask3 = (claims["photos_attached"] == 0) | (claims["amount"] > 500)
    manual_review_rows.append(claims[mask3 & ~matched])
    matched = matched | mask3
    
    # Default port: unmatched rows
    standard_rows.append(claims[~matched])
    
    # Concatenate results for each port
    claims_fast_track = pd.concat(fast_track_rows, ignore_index=False) if fast_track_rows and any(len(df) > 0 for df in fast_track_rows) else pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    claims_high_value = pd.concat(high_value_rows, ignore_index=False) if high_value_rows and any(len(df) > 0 for df in high_value_rows) else pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    claims_manual_review = pd.concat(manual_review_rows, ignore_index=False) if manual_review_rows and any(len(df) > 0 for df in manual_review_rows) else pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    # Ensure proper column selection and types
    if len(claims_fast_track) > 0:
        claims_fast_track = claims_fast_track[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]
    else:
        claims_fast_track = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    if len(claims_high_value) > 0:
        claims_high_value = claims_high_value[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]
    else:
        claims_high_value = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    if len(claims_manual_review) > 0:
        claims_manual_review = claims_manual_review[["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"]]
    else:
        claims_manual_review = pd.DataFrame(columns=["claim_id", "amount", "photos_attached"])
    
    return {
        "claims_fast_track": claims_fast_track,
        "claims_high_value": claims_high_value,
        "claims_manual_review": claims_manual_review
    }
